prompt: I want to add a new AI playground page to the frontend at '/ai/experiment' that lets users enter a custom prompt and see what tracks the AI picks, plus the raw JSON response from the backend. Walk me through creating the Vue page, adding the route, and wiring it up.

assertions.name: registers route in app.ts
assertions.description: Includes registering the route in router/routes/app.ts

assertions.name: uses useAIApi composable
assertions.description: Uses useAIApi() from services/api/ai for the API call

assertions.name: covers all UI states
assertions.description: Covers loading, empty, and results states in the template

assertions.name: displays raw JSON response
assertions.description: Displays the raw JSON response from the backend in a readable format

assertions.name: includes play functionality
assertions.description: Includes play-all or per-track play functionality via usePlayer()

assertions.name: adds navigation link
assertions.description: Adds navigation link in LayoutMusicApp.vue or similar

assertions.name: covers backend changes
assertions.description: Covers backend API changes needed (service, handler, routes)
